# Copper Wren Movement Studio: 2029 Rooftop Showcase Handbook

The Rooftop Showcase technical rehearsal is on 18 October 2029 at 15:30 in Alder Room.
Performers must check in 25 minutes before the technical rehearsal.
A student whose hired kit is unavailable may wear a plain charcoal top only after the teacher approves it.
Showcase recording consent is due on 4 October 2029.
A family may decline recording without losing the student’s showcase place.
The showcase coach leaves Birch Room at 13:20 on 26 October 2029.
The coach return time depends on the show finish and is not published.
Equipment hire must be returned to the office, not the theatre.
A guardian may collect a student after the showcase only from the signed pickup desk.
